设置.通用.界面显示模式.说明: Standard mode: fullest rendering with color emoji; Compatible mode: switch here if the UI renders oddly (no color emoji). Restart the program to apply
设置.通用.双击Ctrl.说明: Press Ctrl twice to summon the chosen window. This feature continuously monitors keyboard input and some antivirus tools may false-flag it; keep it disabled if unused
设置.通用.开机自启动.说明: Start automatically after login (hidden to tray, running as administrator); summon via tray icon, hotkey, or double-Ctrl
设置.窗口.主窗名说明: This is the program's main window, fixed as "Default Window"; it cannot be renamed
设置.窗口.窗口名称.说明: This window's name, to tell apart multiple open search windows; click the button to rename
设置.窗口.快捷键占用说明: This hotkey is taken by another program and is not active; click the button to pick another combo (Esc to cancel)
设置.窗口.快捷键说明: Pressing this hotkey anywhere summons this window; click the button then press a new combo to record it (Esc cancels, Delete clears). No hotkey is occupied while unset
设置.窗口.失焦行为.说明: What to do when this window loses focus; "Close window": the default window hides to the tray, others close (can be reopened anytime)
设置.窗口.出现位置.说明: Where the window appears when summoned or created; "Previous position" keeps it where it was (new windows reuse their remembered spot and size); the others place it at a screen corner, center, or by the mouse, never covering the taskbar
设置.窗口.显示控制按钮.说明: The minimize/maximize/close buttons on the right of the title bar; hiding them frees space for the search box
设置.窗口.显示筛选框.说明: The category filter dropdown in the title bar (filters results by category); hiding it frees space for the search box
设置.窗口.显示状态栏.说明: The status bar at the window bottom (result count/scan progress/selection); hiding it extends the list area to the bottom
设置.窗口.任务栏图标.说明: When off, this window hides from the taskbar and Alt+Tab; still summonable via tray icon, hotkey, or double-Ctrl
设置.搜索匹配.空词显示全部: Show all files when the search box is empty
设置.搜索匹配.空词显示全部.说明: When the search box is empty, list all files directly (sorted by usage frequency)
设置.搜索匹配.区分大小写.说明: Case-sensitive English letters: when on, searching Abc will not match abc
设置.搜索匹配.支持全拼.说明: Typing full pinyin also finds Chinese file names (e.g. suanfa finds 算法.txt)
设置.搜索匹配.支持首拼.说明: Typing pinyin initials also finds Chinese file names (e.g. sf finds 算法.txt)
设置.搜索匹配.拼音整字匹配.说明: Pinyin must align with whole characters; syllables of adjacent characters are not stitched together (more precise, possibly fewer results)
设置.搜索匹配.问号通配符.说明: Use ? in the search word for exactly one character, e.g. report?.docx
设置.搜索匹配.星号通配符.说明: Use * in the search word for any number of characters, e.g. report*.docx
设置.搜索匹配.全角半角: Treat full-width and half-width as identical
设置.搜索匹配.全角半角.说明: Full-width letters/digits match their half-width forms (e.g. Ａ matches A)
设置.外观.界面语言.说明: Choose this window's UI language (简体中文/繁體中文/English/한국어/ไทย/Bahasa Melayu); "Auto" follows the system language (Traditional on TW/HK/MO systems, otherwise Simplified), other systems show English. Per-window setting, takes effect immediately
设置.外观.界面缩放.说明: Scale this window's UI (text/icons/layout) up or down; remembered per window, also adjustable via Ctrl+wheel or Ctrl+plus/minus
设置.外观.无皮肤.说明: Put skin files (skin-*.css) into the "skin" folder in the program directory
设置.列表.默认排序.说明: Sort order of this window's results; clicking the list header to re-sort is remembered and saved too
设置.列表.默认选中.说明: Auto-select the first list item when results update (the preview follows); when on, pressing Enter in the search box opens that item
设置.列表.预览面板.说明: Show a preview of the selected file on the right (image/text/drive info)
设置.列表.驱动器容量条.说明: Show a capacity bar at the bottom of drive rows (redder as it fills up)
设置.列表.悬停高亮.说明: Highlight the row under the mouse
设置.列表.悬停残影.说明: After the mouse leaves, the row's highlight fades out gradually (trailing effect); requires "Hover highlight" first
设置.数据维护.重建索引.说明: Rescan all drives and rebuild the index database; use when files can't be found or the index misbehaves
设置.数据维护.清空历史: Delete all recorded search words (the search box history dropdown)
设置.数据维护.排除目录.说明: The selected directory and everything inside it are removed from the index immediately and skipped in future scans; the exclusion survives index rebuilds
设置.数据维护.手动输入路径.说明: Type a directory's full path (e.g. F:\abc) and press Enter to add; handy for directories that do not exist yet
设置.数据维护.点击添加提示: Click "Add directory" to pick a folder to exclude
设置.打开.鼠标打开方式.说明: Open list files by double-click or single-click; in single-click mode, press-drag still drags files out, and Ctrl/Shift+click still multi-selects
设置.打开.以管理员权限打开.说明: On: opened files/programs also run as administrator; Off: open with normal privileges, better compatibility
设置.打开.后台打开文件.说明: Opens in the background so the search window won't freeze when the associated program starts slowly
设置.打开.打开后隐藏窗口: Hide window after opening a file
设置.打开.打开后隐藏窗口.说明: After opening, the search window auto-hides to the tray (results kept); summon it back via tray icon or hotkey
设置.新建窗口.初始搜索词.说明: Content pre-filled in the search box when creating a window, with one search run before it appears (results ready at first sight); "Last searched word" reuses that window's last word, or the launching window's current word if it never searched
设置.新建窗口.指定关键词.说明: In "Specified keyword" mode, the word filled in and searched when creating a window; click the button to change (empty = none)
设置.新建窗口.执行首搜说明: In "Specified keyword" mode, new windows run one search with this word (leave empty = none)
设置.窗口管理.重命名说明: Enter a new window name (empty = keep, max 40 characters)
设置.窗口管理.主窗后缀: · Main window, name is fixed and cannot be renamed
设置.窗口管理.删除确认后缀: "? Its settings cannot be recovered after deletion.
设置.窗口管理.删除确认.正在打开: This window is currently open and will be closed as well.
设置.窗口管理.删除确认.双击Ctrl目标: This window is the double-Ctrl launch target; after deletion, double-Ctrl launch will be disabled.
设置.窗口管理.删除确认.专属模式后缀: custom search mode(s) will also be deleted.

设置.插件.插件目录.说明: Open the plugins folder to add or remove plugins (one subfolder per plugin).
设置.插件.重新扫描.说明: Re-read the plugins folder: discover new plugins and refresh manifests. A replaced DLL takes effect after restart.
设置.插件.无插件.说明: Put plugin folders into the plugins folder, then click Rescan.
设置.插件.需重启说明: Plugin files updated; restart to apply.
设置.插件.权限.界面操作: UI actions (read selection, set search text, open paths)
设置.插件.权限.设置: Read/write app settings (read/change window settings, manage search modes)
设置.插件.确认.风险原文: Native plugins run with the same permissions as the host (this program runs as administrator); direct engine access bypasses permission gates. Permissions are declared intent only - only enable plugins from trusted sources.
设置.内存.内存页锁定.说明: Uses large memory pages (2MB) to reduce page-table overhead and improve random access; the switch follows the real system permission state instantly, and granting/removing requires administrator and a sign-out/sign-in to take effect
设置.内存.状态已启用: Enabled, large pages available to this process
设置.内存.状态已授予: Granted, takes effect after signing out and back in
设置.内存.状态未启用: Granted, not enabled in this process
设置.内存.状态已移除: Grant has been removed (this session still holds the privilege until sign-out/restart); toggle on to restore it
设置.性能.引擎未就绪: Engine not ready (database not loaded yet)
设置.性能.加载保存统计.说明: Records time spent in each database load/save stage; turn on when diagnosing slow start or slow exit, click "Clear" to restart sampling
设置.性能.遍历统计.说明: Records time spent in each full-disk scan/rebuild stage; turn on when diagnosing slow rebuilds, click "Clear" to restart sampling
设置.性能.同步统计.说明: Records time spent in each file-change sync stage; click "Clear" to restart sampling for comparison
设置.文件分类.说明: Categorize files by extension; this feeds the category filter bar below the search box. The type number uniquely identifies a category (1~254 are custom and must be unique; 0=All and 255=Folders only need a name, no extensions). Separate extensions with commas.
设置.文件分类.生效说明: Sent to the engine immediately after saving: only files indexed afterwards are affected; recategorizing already indexed files requires rebuilding the index.
提示.分类已保存: File categories saved (applies to newly indexed files)
错误.分类名称为空: Some category names are empty; fill them in before saving
错误.分类类型范围: Category “type” must be an integer from 0 to 255
设置.别名.说明: Preset display aliases for files under a given path (the “Alias” column in the list; searchable via SQL on the Alias field). One entry per line: “full path = alias”.
设置.别名.生效说明: Paths support the <SystemDrive> and <UserName> placeholders. Changes take effect immediately after saving, persist with settings, and are restored on restart.
错误.别名路径为空: Some paths are empty; fill them in or remove those rows before saving
错误.表格配置无效: Invalid configuration: please check your entries
错误.数据库正忙: Database is busy (scanning/saving/loading), please try again later
错误.表格保存失败: Save failed, please try again later
